goal: Deterministically separate lexical HRAiN discovery noise from candidates eligible to join the Egyptian evidence corpus, without semantic scoring or human eyeballing.
input_freeze: Exactly the 57 HRAIN_PATH_DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE paths already frozen inside EGY-KG v1.0. No new search and no network enrichment are allowed in this gate.

boundary_check.scope: candidate path against the matched_path_terms frozen in EGY-KG v1.0
boundary_check.normalization: lowercase; split path and terms on every non-[a-z0-9] character; discard empty tokens
boundary_check.single_token_rule: single-token term passes only by exact token equality
boundary_check.multi_token_rule: multi-token term passes only when the normalized token sequence occurs contiguously in the normalized candidate path
boundary_check.pass_rule: At least one frozen matched_path_term passes the exact token/sequence test.

schema_alignment.key_normalization: lowercase JSON object keys; hyphen and space normalized to underscore
schema_alignment.pass_rule: A syntactically valid JSON candidate must contain at least one required structured key anywhere in its object tree.

provenance_anchor.allowed_core: Exactly the 49 frozen inventory entries with primary_tier SOURCE_PROVENANCE_EPIGRAPHY.
provenance_anchor.rule: An anchor counts only when an exact core path or artifact_id occurs in a string value whose JSON Pointer contains at least one allowed pointer token.
provenance_anchor.derived_edge: The admission result may record EXPLICIT_PROVENANCE_ANCHOR from the candidate to the frozen core object; EGY-KG v1.0 itself is not mutated.

candidate_integrity.rule: Each candidate file SHA-256 must exactly match the SHA-256 stored on its HRAIN_PATH_DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE node in frozen EGY-KG v1.0.

admission_rule: ADMITTED_TO_EVIDENCE_CORPUS only if BOUNDARY_CHECK=PASS AND SCHEMA_ALIGNMENT=PASS AND PROVENANCE_ANCHOR=PASS.

determinism.rerun_requirement: same frozen inputs and apparatus must produce byte-identical result JSON

pass_condition: All 57 frozen candidates are integrity-checked and deterministically classified under the frozen three-stage rules; no candidate bypasses a failed earlier filter; scoring remains locked.
canonical_seal: FIRST PROVE THE NAME IS A TOKEN, THEN PROVE THE OBJECT HAS AN EVIDENCE-COMPATIBLE SCHEMA, THEN PROVE AN EXPLICIT ANCHOR TO THE FROZEN EPIGRAPHIC CORE. ONLY THREE PASSES MAY ADMIT A HRAIN DISCOVERY INTO THE EVIDENCE CORPUS.
